name: Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
summary: Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret AS engages in the production, packaging, and marketing of tea. It offers bulk teas, teapot bag, cup bag tea, form fruit and herbal teas, OPA Ceylon teas, and out-of-home consumption products. The company was founded by Emrah Sever and Ramazan Tok in 2005 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
